name: 빈 낯의 시울
silhouette: 공중에 떠 있는 거대한 책 날개, 머리 위의 날카로운 종이 뿔, 길게 뻗은 붓 형태의 무기, 펄럭이는 황금빛 망토
signature_vfx: Three swirling spectral orbs of white light
visual_en: A translucent, pale emerald-skinned entity with a 2-unit scale body, facing right. On top of the head, sharp paper-like horns made of ink-stained parchment protrude. Large, flowing wings shaped like open ancient books float behind the back, decorated with rich gold ornaments. The character wears a deep navy robe adorned with lavish golden embroidery and a flowing cape that leaves a trail of luminous white particles. Floating around the character are several ancient books and a large, golden quill-like weapon resembling a sinawi brush. Three bright, white spectral orbs orbit the character's back. The overall silhouette is defined by the sharp edges of the paper wings and the bright, glowing golden accents that pierce through the darkness.
pose_en: Floating eerily with a calm, detached posture.
vfx_en: Three bright white glowing orbs swirling in a circular pattern.
lore: 도서관 보스. 반투명하게 어른거린다(투명 처리는 게임이). 돌진 대신 사라졌다가 플레이어 옆에 나타난다. 따라오는 원혼탄 3발을 쏘고 시나위를 불러낸다.

anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground
